properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued September 6 at 11:23PM MDT until September 7 at 1:30AM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Larimer County in north central Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 130 AM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 1123 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1.25 and 1.75 inches of
rain have fallen.

- This includes the following streams and drainages...
Sand Creek, Spottlewood Creek, Rawhide Creek, Spring Creek,
Rabbit Creek, Park Creek, Coal Creek, Boxelder Creek, North Fork
Cache La Poudre River, Lonetree Creek, Lone Pine Creek and Dry
Creek. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Livermore, Buckeye and Owl Canyon.
